locations.title: Zombie Statue
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Main Quest [The Saviors](#loc=69462)

**From [Old Town Sewers Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/dying-light/maps/old-town?locationIds=66906):** Run downstairs to find yourself in the large open pavilion.  The statue is on one of the tables that surround the tree in the middle.

**From [Slums Sewers Entrance](#loc=68953):**  Traverse through the tunnels following the painted arrows until you need to swim through an underwater pipe to continue up a ladder and back on the ground.  

In the area following, find the gray door with the arrow painted on the wall next to it.  Head through the door and to the left through the tunnels, following the painted arrows until you get to a ladder.  

Climb up the ladders and into the building basement.  Head upstairs to find yourself in a pavilion with a tree in the middle, surrounded by tables.  The statue is on one of the tables.

locations.title: Zombie Statue
locations.description:
**From [Slums Sewers Entrance](#loc=68953):**  Traverse through the tunnels following the painted arrows until you need to swim through an underwater pipe to continue up a ladder and back on the ground.  

In the area following, find the gray door with the arrow painted on the wall next to it.  Head through the door and to the right.  Go up the incline and turn left, heading down the tunnel and through the pipe.  

In the room with the water below, climb up the yellow pipes (or use the grappling hook) to the top.  Head through the pipe and out into the outdoors area.  Find the shack with the statue inside on the table to the left, immediately after entry.

locations.title: Call Of Juarez Easter Egg
locations.description:
A plethora of items can be found inside Crane's room in the tower, including a Ray McCall figurine. Ray is the protagonist of Call of Juarez and Call of Juarez: Bound in Blood. These games were developed by Techland (who also created Dying Light.)

For an extra bit of fun, you can interact with the figurine to hear a few voice lines.
